about: Japan's MHLW-designated critical care centres (救命救急センター) with the ministry's 2025 evaluation, parsed from the MHLW files below by hand-checked pdftotext layout parsing (item scores sum to each centre's total). Placed on OpenStreetMap hospitals by name near the GSI address search point, else at the GSI point. Rebuild source/sof/jp.json with tools/build_jp_ccc.py.
